print("Scanning finished")

import nanosurf
import time
import os
import glob

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application
scan = application.Scan

# Set scan parameters for 10x10 µm² scan
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters

print(f"Starting 10x10 µm² scan...")
print(f"Image Width: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6} µm")
print(f"Image Height: {scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm")

# Get the workspace directory
workspace_dir = r"C:\Users\Admin\Desktop\corral\corral\tasks\afm\src\afm\claude-sonnet-4-5_subtasks_1_tool_calling\enviroment\subtasks_1"

# Get list of existing .nid files before scan
existing_files = set()
for root, dirs, files in os.walk(workspace_dir):
    for file in files:
        if file.endswith('.nid'):
            existing_files.add(os.path.join(root, file))

print(f"Found {len(existing_files)} existing .nid files before scan")

# Start scan
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished")

# Wait a moment for file to be saved
time.sleep(2)

# Find the new .nid file
new_files = set()
for root, dirs, files in os.walk(workspace_dir):
    for file in files:
        if file.endswith('.nid'):
            new_files.add(os.path.join(root, file))

# Find the difference
newly_created = new_files - existing_files

if newly_created:
    new_file_path = list(newly_created)[0]
    print(f"New scan saved to: {new_file_path}")
else:
    print("Warning: Could not find newly created .nid file")
    # List all .nid files sorted by modification time
    all_nid_files = []
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(workspace_dir):
        for file in files:
            if file.endswith('.nid'):
                full_path = os.path.join(root, file)
                all_nid_files.append((full_path, os.path.getmtime(full_path)))
    
    if all_nid_files:
        # Sort by modification time (most recent first)
        all_nid_files.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
        new_file_path = all_nid_files[0][0]
        print(f"Most recent .nid file: {new_file_path}")

del spm

print(f"Absolute path: {absolute_path}")

del spm

import nanosurf
import time
import os
import glob

# Define workspace directory
workspace_dir = r"C:\Users\Admin\Desktop\corral\corral\tasks\afm\src\afm\claude-sonnet-4-5_subtasks_1_tool_calling\enviroment\subtasks_1"

# Get list of files before scan
files_before = set(glob.glob(os.path.join(workspace_dir, "**", "*.*"), recursive=True))

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get scan object
scan = application.Scan

# Configure scan parameters for 10x10 µm²
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters

print(f"Configured scan size: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6} x {scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm²")

# Start scan (from bottom to top)
scan.StartFrameUp()
print("Scan started...")

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished")

# Wait a moment for file to be written
time.sleep(2)

# Get list of files after scan
files_after = set(glob.glob(os.path.join(workspace_dir, "**", "*.*"), recursive=True))

# Find new files
new_files = files_after - files_before

if new_files:
    # Get the most recent file
    newest_file = max(new_files, key=os.path.getmtime)
    print(f"New scan file created: {newest_file}")
    absolute_path = os.path.abspath(newest_file)
    print(f"Absolute path: {absolute_path}")
else:
    print("No new files detected in workspace")

del spm

scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters

print(f"Scan points: {scan.Points} x {scan.Lines}")
print(f"Scan time per line: {scan.Scantime} s")

scan.StartFrameUp()  # Scanning from bottom to top

scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:

    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining}")

import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get scan object
scan = application.Scan

# Configure scan parameters for 10x10 µm²
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.Points = 256  # points per line
scan.Lines = 256  # lines per frame

print(f"Scan configured: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6} x {scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm²")
print(f"Resolution: {scan.Points} x {scan.Lines} pixels")

# Start scan
scan.StartFrameUp()  # Scanning from bottom to top
print("Scan started...")

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Save the image to the workspace directory
workspace_dir = r"C:\Users\Admin\Desktop\corral\corral\tasks\afm\src\afm\claude-sonnet-4-5_subtasks_1_tool_calling\enviroment\subtasks_1"
os.makedirs(workspace_dir, exist_ok=True)

# Create filename with timestamp
timestamp = time.strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
filename = f"afm_scan_10x10um_{timestamp}.nid"
filepath = os.path.join(workspace_dir, filename)

# Save the scan
scan.SaveImage(filepath)
print(f"Image saved to: {filepath}")

# Store the path for retrieval
with open(os.path.join(workspace_dir, "last_scan_path.txt"), "w") as f:
    f.write(filepath)

del spm

scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters

    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining}")

    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished")

# Get the file path - the AFM software automatically saves the scan

    filename = None

    print(f"FINAL_PATH: {filename}")
else:

import nanosurf
import time
import os
import glob

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application
scan = application.Scan

# Set a specific filename for this scan
workspace_dir = r"C:\Users\Admin\Desktop\corral\corral\tasks\afm\src\afm\claude-sonnet-4-5_subtasks_1_tool_calling\enviroment\subtasks_1"
os.makedirs(workspace_dir, exist_ok=True)

# Set filename mask
timestamp = time.strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
file_name = f"scan_10x10um_{timestamp}-"
application.SetGalleryHistoryFilenameMask(file_name)

# Configure scan parameters for 10x10 µm²
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.Points = 256  # points per line
scan.Lines = 256  # lines per frame

print(f"Scan configured: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6} x {scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm²")
print(f"Resolution: {scan.Points} x {scan.Lines} pixels")
print(f"Filename mask set to: {file_name}")

# Start scan
scan.StartFrameUp()
print("Scan started...")

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Give some time for file to be saved
time.sleep(2)

# Try to find the saved file
# Check common AFM data directories
possible_paths = [
    workspace_dir,
    os.path.join(os.path.expanduser("~"), "Documents"),
    r"C:\Users\Admin\Documents",
    r"C:\ProgramData\Nanosurf",
]

saved_file = None
for path in possible_paths:
    if os.path.exists(path):
        # Look for .nid files with our filename pattern
        pattern = os.path.join(path, f"{file_name}*.nid")
        files = glob.glob(pattern)
        if files:
            # Get the most recent file
            saved_file = max(files, key=os.path.getctime)
            break

if saved_file:
    print(f"Scan file found at: {saved_file}")
else:
    print("Could not locate saved file automatically")

del spm
